Hello, hello!
You’re going to battle here, right?{be01}
Can you tell me what’s going through
your mind as you prepare for battle?
Oh, wow, you’ll tell me?\nGreat! Then, what’s your answer?
啊，那么说你并不会\n多想吗？看来是个沉\n着的人啊。
哎？你改主意了吗？\n看来你是个易变的人\n啊。
嗯，你是这么想的吗\n？很有新意啊。{be01}\n谢谢！
I suggest you keep it displayed.\nIt will surely attract attention.

Oh?
Your PC has no room for this...{be01}
But it would be a shame to waste this...
Please come back for this!

I’m overwhelmed with satisfaction after
seeing your magnificent performance.{be01}

如果您在挑战途中想

请确保在暂停前完好
地写下了记录。否则
我们将视挑战为无效
。
